fieldValues.title: Views L2
fieldValues.extension_adds: Document-level projection: assembling multiple Records into a rendered document via a `Composition`, dispatching each section's field content to an L1 `View`, with its own `ExportConfig` attachment point for document-level rendering (distinct from the one on `View` itself) and ordering support including `DocumentSection.ordering.memberOrder`. Requires `ext:views-l1`, whose per-record field rendering it composes over.
fieldValues.extension_cost_of_non_adoption: Without it, an implementation can render a single Record through an L1 `View` but cannot assemble multiple Records into a composed, multi-section document — there is no `Composition` to dispatch sections to Views, order members, or attach document-level `ExportConfig`.

sourceRefs.note: Extension ext:views-l2 from srs-spec.md - coarse source anchoring during migration
